name: Crash My Party
aliases: Crash My Party Luke Bryan Tribute
Crash My Party - The Ultimate Luke Bryan Tribute Band

evidence.note: Band's own show diary mentions a Memorial Day brewery show with line dancing on Long Island.
Daisy's Nashville Lounge in Miller Place held a 'Dine and Dance' line-dancing dinner in Aug 2026.
Booking agent page describes a fun, energetic Luke Bryan tribute.

dancing.notes: A country party band. The band notes a show with line dancing, and its Oct 3 venue, Daisy's in Miller Place, is a country bar that hosts line-dance nights.

description: A Long Island tribute band led by singer Casey Wayne that plays Luke Bryan's country hits at bars, breweries and theaters.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). No two-step evidence found. The band also plays seated theaters (Smithtown PAC, Paramount) where dancing is less likely. No official Facebook/Instagram confirmed.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Facebook and Instagram are now confirmed (linked from the band's own contact page). The (516) number is the booking line of the band's company (CW Events LLC). The domain lukebryantributeband.com in the email does not load as a website; the Wix address is the working site. Current description is still accurate. Logo is white on black.

logo.alt: Crash My Party logo: big distressed letters CMP inside a ring of text reading The Ultimate Luke Bryan Tribute Band, white on black

evidence.note: Official site: Crash My Party, the Ultimate Luke Bryan Tribute Band, created by singer Casey Wayne; booking by email.
Booking via CW Events LLC: info@lukebryantributeband.com and (516) 652-8111; page links Facebook /LukeBryanTributeBand and Instagram /LukeBryanTributeBand.
Pics and Places page shows the debut show at 89 North (Patchogue), a set at Great South Bay Brewery and a Paramount (Huntington) poster, confirming the Long Island base.
